exposure: Women with adverse pregnancy outcomes vs. women without adverse outcomes
outcome: Systolic and diastolic blood pressures during hospitalization
cohort: 100 women with singleton pregnancies admitted for evaluation of preeclampsia at less than 37 weeks of gestation
finding: Women at risk for adverse pregnancy outcomes had higher sFlt-1/PlGF ratios on admission for preeclampsia, which continued to rise until delivery, and delivered sooner than women with low sFlt-1/PlGF levels.
